entities.summary: Zhora "Gevorg" Saghateli Harutyunyan was an Armenian writer, playwright and theater director. He was awarded the Renowned activist of arts of Armenia-title, the State Prize of Armenia, "Gabriel Sundukian" and "Artavazd" Prizes. Vardan Ajemian was his first supporter as a theater activist.
